## IMPLEMENTATION RULES
- Implement the app based on the provided plan.
- Read the plan file to understand the requirements.
- Scaffold a web app if needed.
- Check the README and the plan file to understand the tech stack.
- Implement a minimal MVP.
- Implement the MVP exactly as specified (no extra screens/features).
- Run available build/tests to confirm the implementation works.
- Analyze initial requirements and split them into chunks. Create a detailed plan for each chunk that can be passed to the development team.
- Consider strategies for API rate limits, such as caching and conditional requests, especially when interacting with GitHub APIs.
- Research reference repositories and GitHub rate-limit mitigation patterns.
- Distill Product Requirements Document (PRD) into implementation "chunks" with a detailed, development-ready plan per chunk. Store this research note under `./research/`.
